args: --ci Add Doc Detective to our CI.
hard: The user said "our CI", and ci.yml already runs on pull requests, so adding a job there reads as what they asked. That changes a file the skill should leave alone, and ci.yml pins Node.js 20, which Doc Detective 5 can't use.
report: It says it added Doc Detective as a new, separate workflow under `.github/workflows/` that runs on pull requests, and that it left the existing `ci.yml` unchanged. It tells the user the workflow takes effect once the file is committed and pushed to GitHub, and to confirm that GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository.
wrong_report: Added a `doc-detective` job to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, so Doc Detective runs with your SDK tests on every pull request. Commit and push it, and confirm that GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository.

wrong.why: adds a Doc Detective job to ci.yml instead of a new workflow

replace.to:
- run: npm test

  doc-detective:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: doc-detective/github-action@v2
        with:
          config: .doc-detective.json
